title: Title / save select
kicker: Session and shell · how you play
hook: At the **door** you meet the title screen, then **choose or create a summoner save** — that save is the world you keep.

blindSpots.meaning: The first control-room screen after the launcher opens the browser — Rise of Summoner’s front door, not the lawn game’s main menu.
One local profile for your whole campaign: roster, stocks, map progress. Picked once at the door, not from a dropdown on every screen.
Resume with the summoner the control room already has selected. Disabled until you have created at least one save.
The Plants vs. Zombies pack’s own save files. Rise of Summoner does not rewrite them. This page is only about RPG saves.

alsoTrue: Saves live on your machine beside the local helper — no account, no cloud. See [local control room](local-control-room).
Updating Rise of Summoner is meant to keep this data.

sections.title: What you see — title
paras: Centered title: Rise of Summoner, with a short Plants vs. Zombies line underneath.
Buttons: Continue, New summoner, Saves, Settings, and Quit (Quit may be unavailable in the browser-only path).

cards.name: Continue
cards.body: Goes straight to the Sanctum with the current summoner. Greyed out if you have never created one.

cards.name: New summoner
cards.body: Opens save select already ready to name a new profile.

cards.name: Settings
cards.body: Opens System over Sanctum — same settings surface you reach with Esc later.

sections.title: What you see — choose a summoner
paras: Each slot shows the name, when it was created, and a world seed for that save.
Continue on a slot selects it and lands you in the Sanctum. + New summoner asks for a name, creates the save, then continues.
sections.note: Back to title returns to the door without changing who is selected.

sections.title: Why the door exists
paras: A save is chosen once, at the door — not from a picker glued to the top of every layer.
That keeps Sanctum feeling like a place you are in, not a settings page that happens to have a game under it.

doSteps: From the title, pick New summoner (or Saves if you already have one).
Type a summoner name and Create — or Continue on an existing slot.
Land in the Sanctum. You are past the door.
doNote: Stop here when you know which summoner you are playing. Next: [Sanctum](sanctum).

mixUps.q: Is this my Plants vs. Zombies save?
mixUps.a: No. This is the Rise of Summoner summoner profile. The lawn pack keeps its own saves.

mixUps.q: Do I need an online account?
mixUps.a: No. Local only — see [local control room](local-control-room).

mixUps.q: Where did the player picker on every screen go?
mixUps.a: On purpose. You pick at the door; you do not re-pick from a HUD dropdown all session.

mixUps.q: What is the seed under my name?
mixUps.a: A label for this save’s world root. You can see it; you do not need to type it to play.

mixUps.q: Can I have more than one summoner?
mixUps.a: Yes. Create another slot from Saves or New summoner, then Continue on the one you want.
